proposedBy.onBehalfOf: the owner (KineTrak), on their request to review and propose

statement: Dependencies for people, while agents keep declaring them: (1) show both directions in the panel — Depends on, and Needed by; (2) an empty state that says none is declared and how one gets there, instead of rendering nothing; (3) say who declared each one and when (agent or person, from the activity log), and let a person remove a wrong one with undo; (4) adding by a type-to-find list (variant a-picker), not by dragging on the canvas; (5) draw the selected feature's dependencies on the Mindmap only while it is selected; (6) give the Sample board two or three dependencies so a newcomer sees one.

evidence.what: src/components/panel/DetailPanel.tsx:200 — Dependencies returns null when empty and has no remove or add; no view draws dependsOn on the canvas
the board is the agent's memory: a person reviewing it must see where a dependency came from and correct a wrong one, or the impact answer inherits the mistake

b-connect overloads the canvas gesture the Swimlane already uses for flow arrows (blue dots), and needs precise dragging (Fitts); a-picker is keyboard-reachable — Linear adds relations from the panel and the command menu
